_format: See docs/team/basecamp.md. cost: array (price per rank, last repeats) or number (+ cost_growth). effects: {stat, per_level} applies Player.apply_stat; {type: weapon, scene} grants a starting weapon; other types are read with Meta.effect_total(type).

blacksmith.name: Grimmaul
blacksmith.title: Blacksmith of the Ninth Forge
blacksmith.greeting: Steel quenched in sinners' tears. Bring souls, leave sharper.

occultist.name: Vesper Ashtongue
occultist.title: Occultist of the Black Choir
occultist.greeting: Every rite has a price. Yours is merely souls. For now.

soul_broker.name: Mammon's Clerk
soul_broker.title: Soul Broker
soul_broker.greeting: Souls in, interest out. The ledger never forgets a debt.

covenant.name: The Covenant
covenant.title: Pacts of Heat, kept by Mammon's Clerk
covenant.greeting: Sign in blood. The harder Heaven hunts you, the more the Ledger pays.

pit.name: The Proving Pit
pit.title: Where the damned learn their new tricks
pit.greeting: Bind a rite or three. The straw angels are very forgiving.

cartographer.name: Wayfarer Ossek
cartographer.title: Cartographer of the Fallen Roads
cartographer.greeting: The Heavens have many doors. I know which ones bleed.

upgrades.name: Blood Pact
upgrades.description: Regenerate 0.2 vigor per second per rank.

upgrades.name: Bound Sigil
upgrades.description: Begin every hunt with the Brimstone Sigil already inscribed.

upgrades.name: Tithe of the Damned
upgrades.description: +10% souls earned per hunt, per rank.
